name_reason: Function is the CHURCH-REVIVE candidate picker, not a class-promotion picker. Sole caller is fd2_run_revive_menu_main @ 0x30E90 (the revive menu), and the caller's payoff is revive semantics (clear dead flag + restore HP). The 'promote' in the current name is a historical misnomer inherited from the caller's old name fd2_run_promote_menu_main (already corrected to fd2_run_revive_menu_main). Today the only thing distinguishing this fn from the genuine promotion picker fd2_promote_member_select_loop @ 0x311DC is the fragile plural/singular 'members' vs 'member'. Renaming to fd2_revive_member_select_loop makes the domain distinction self-documenting (revive vs promote) and parallels the sibling. No address residue; 'member' is a domain word. Apply in Stage 2 (touches protos.h:804, caller promote.c:994, and doc cross-refs in aniui.c / rndmenu.c / shop.c / globals.h plate).
purpose: Church-revive candidate selection loop: builds the panel, slides it in, runs the Up/Down cursor navigation over the dead-member list, and returns whether the user committed (1) or cancelled (-1).
logic_summary: result=0. malloc 3 x 64000-byte (mode 13h) workspaces (anim_accumulator, bg_snapshot, composed_target). Snapshot VGA 0xA0000 -> bg_snapshot, clone bg_snapshot -> composed_target. Reset ui_menu_scroll_offset=0 and ui_menu_cursor_idx=0; stash candidate_idx_list into ui_menu_candidate_array_ptr and candidate_count into ui_menu_visible_item_count for the re-render path. Blit the panel sprite (atlas offset +0x46) into composed_target+0x8C05, render the initial grid via fd2_render_promote_members_grid, then play a 6-frame slide-down reveal (frame_iter 5..0, y = 0x70 + frame_iter*0xD) via fd2_slide_panel_down_step. Input loop: scancode = fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink(2). Up(0x48): if cursor!=0, cursor--, if cursor<scroll_offset then scroll_offset-- + animate_scroll_down, re-render. Down(0x50): if cursor<candidate_count-1, cursor++, if cursor-scroll_offset>2 then scroll_offset++ + animate_scroll_up, re-render. Enter(0x1C)/Space(0x39): result=1. Esc(0x01): result=-1. Loop until result!=0; return result. Buffers are intentionally NOT freed here -- caller cleans up via fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out (shared 3-buffer state). Viewport shows 3 items, scrolling 1 step at a time (vs the shop's 2-step).

params.name: candidate_count
params.semantics: Number of revive-eligible (dead) party members in the list; caller passes dead_count from fd2_build_dead_chars_list_for_revive. Used as the Down-arrow clamp (cursor < candidate_count-1) and forwarded to the grid renderer and stashed into ui_menu_visible_item_count.
params.reason: Accurate (it is the candidate count) and free of address residue.

params.name: candidate_idx_list
params.semantics: Pointer to the byte array of dead-member runtime_char indices to display; caller passes its local candidate_chars[32]. Stashed into ui_menu_candidate_array_ptr for the re-render path and forwarded to fd2_render_promote_members_grid.
params.reason: Accurate (the candidate index list) and free of address residue.

returns.semantics: 1 = user committed the highlighted candidate (Enter 0x1C / Space 0x39); -1 = user cancelled (Esc 0x01). Caller treats -1 as 'exit revive menu' and uses ui_menu_cursor_idx to identify the chosen candidate after a commit.
